title: Signed speed limits by road portion
description: The same OSM measurement that drives speeds.py, exported unreduced so a reader can see where the limits are rather than take eight class averages on trust. Its point is visual: below motorway the open-road limit is the national 90 on every class, and what separates a trunk road from a communal one is how much of it drops to 50 through villages. Untagged is a band in its own right and is never filled with a default — a quarter of these kilometres have no maxspeed recorded, concentrated on the small roads where the model needs them most.

coverage.description: Share of kilometres carrying a numeric maxspeed. Below 1 by a wide margin, and that gap is the honest content of the layer.

kmByBand.description: Kilometres per signed value, plus `untagged`. Keys are strings because one of them is not a number.
